issue.body:
Fixes #72337

## Summary
- Cancelled backfills set `is_paused=True` and `completed_at` but never clear `is_paused`.
- Cleared queued DagRuns from a cancelled backfill stayed unschedulable because `get_queued_dag_runs_to_set_running` blocked on stale `Backfill.is_paused`.
- Allow promotion when `Backfill.completed_at` is set and add regression coverage.

## Test plan
- [x] Added `test_get_queued_dag_runs_includes_cancelled_backfill_runs`.
- [x] Breeze: `pytest airflow-core/tests/unit/models/test_dagrun.py::TestDagRun::test_get_queued_dag_runs_includes_cancelled_backfill_runs -q` (1 passed on the rebased branch).
- [x] Ruff lint, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Current-head hosted CI is running after the rebase. The previous MySQL Serialization failure was a `test_trigger_log` 300-second blocked-thread timeout.
